test_key_rule: sha256(utf8(label)) is the raw private key; these are public test labels, never production keys

json_boundary.rule: §2.3: strict JSON applies to wire bytes; a legal JSON escape \u0000 in a carried DSH value is accepted and preserved, while a literal 0x00 byte, BOM, duplicate member, lone surrogate and non-object root are rejected; PCLink-owned fields keep their own field rules

admin_peer.rule: the /api/pclink.admin/* handler decides by the request source Peer, not by the endpoint string; the forwarder prefix check is a fast path only

approval.rule: v1.6: the verified pair.auth proves possession of the one-time screen secret and is approved automatically; the fingerprint is display/unpair-target normalization only
